newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet breaks off Belgian waffle bakers.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet breaks off Belgian waffle bakers.

text.p: Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc said on Wednesday that as part the reorganisation of its food interests it had sold a three Belgian-based bakery businesses to local holding firm Compagnie Nationale a Portfeuille S.A..
The total purchase price, including the assumption of debt, is 8.5 million stg, the company said in a statement.
The three companues, which manufacture, market and sell waffles, biscuits and cakes in Benelux, are Suzy NV, Desobry SA and Driehoek Holdings BV.
Combined sales for these businesses for the financial year ended 30 September 1996 were approximately 29 million stg and their operating profits for the same period were 0.1 million.

Grandmet said the disposals were consistent with its declared strategy for its packaged food business of focusing on its major international food brands in Europe -- Pillsbury, Green Giant, Haagen-Dazs and Old El Paso.
